RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, August 7, 2015/Sravana 16, 1937 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Communications and
Information Technology; Consumer Affairs, Food and
Public Distribution; Food Processing Industries;
Law and Justice; Railways; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 15
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Installation of bio-toilets in trains
running on earmarked tracks
*196. SHRI PAUL MANOJ
PANDIAN: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Railways
have earmarked 367 kilometres of tracks
all over the country to be made human
waste discharge free, if so, the details
thereof;
(b) whether it is also a fact that bio-
toilets will be installed in trains running on
these stretches; and
(c) if so, the steps taken in this regard?
Policy to ensure minimum income for
farmers
†*197. SHRI PRABHAT JHA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the main crisis of Indian
agriculture has been low agricultural income
which is a result of long standing
discrepancies in agriculture policy, if so,
the details thereof; and
(b) whether Government proposes to
formulate a comprehensive policy to ensure
a certain income to the farmers, if so, the
details thereof?
Farmers leaving their ancestral
profession
*198. SHRI NEERAJ SHEKHAR: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that a
number of farmers have left their ancestral
profession of farming and are migrating to
cities for employment after the damage of
crop due to heavy rains during March and
April this year, if so, the details thereof,
State-wise;
(b) whether Government would conduct
any survey to ascertain the exact number of
farmers who have left their profession
during the current year, if so, the details
thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the details of measures Government

67
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
would take to prevent farmers from leaving
their ancestral profession?
Erosion of BSNL subscriber base
*199. SHRIMATI VANDANA
CHAV AN: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION  TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the subscriber base of BSNL
has eroded over a period, if so, the reasons
therefor; and the number of subscribers
added to BSNL in the past three years;
(b)  the number of subscribers lost by
BSNL due to Mobile Number Portability,
the reasons therefor and the loss of
Government exchequer due to the same;
(c) why BSNL is unable to provide
better network connectivity and the steps
taken to improve the same;
(d) the number of qualified staff to
address the broadband and mobile related
complaints, State-wise; and
(e) whether Government would take
any steps to improve the functioning of
BSNL?
Excessive use of chemical fertilizers
and insecticides
†*200. DR. VIJA YLAXMI SADHO:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE  be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of the
hazards/diseases arising out of the excessive
use of chemical fertilizers and insecticides
in agriculture in the country;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
and
(c) the steps taken/being taken by
Government to check the excessive use of
chemical fertilizers and insecticides, the
details thereof?
Recommendations in the Shanta
Kumar Committee Report
*201. PROF. M.V . RAJEEV GOWDA:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry has taken
cognizance of the Shanta Kumar High Level
Committee's Report on re-orienting the role
and re-structuring of the Food Corporation
of India (FCI);
(b) whether the Ministry has plans to
implement any of the major
recommendations made by this Committee,
like re-evaluation of National Food Security
Act, Negotiable Warehouse Receipt System
and direct cash transfers in Public
Distribution System (PDS);
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
timeline therefor; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Allocation of pending amount to
Chhattisgarh for agricultural
schemes
†*202. DR. BHUSHAN LAL
JANGDE: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether approval for the seven new
Krishi Vigyan Kendras at Bemetara, Balod,
Mungeli, Sarguja, Kondagaon, Raipur and
Sukma in Chhattisgarh is pending with
Centre, if so, by when this approval will
be accorded;
(b) by when the pending amount of

68
interim allocation under Rashtriya Krishi
Vikas Yojana and the allocation sanctioned
for the sub-scheme of Green Revolution
Extension would be released to
Chhattisgarh; and
(c) by when the action plan for this
year under Sub Mission on Plant Protection
and Plant Quarantine (SMPP) would be
approved and amount released to
Chhattisgarh?
Slow-down in launching of new drugs
*203. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the Minister
of CHEMICALS AND FERTILIZERS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government's
drugs

————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, August 7, 2015/Sravana 16, 1937 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Communications and
Information Technology; Consumer Affairs, Food and
Public Distribution; Food Processing Industries;
Law and Justice; Railways; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 160
Group insurance under crop
insurance schemes
2081.  SHRI HUSAIN DALW AI: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the current crop insurance
schemes run by Government allow group
insurance to be taken by Self Help Groups
(SHGs), Farmer Producing Organisations
(FPOs) and Cooperative Societies; and
(b) if so, the data for group insurances
taken by each of these groups for the year
2012-13, 2013-14 and 2014-15, State-wise
and if not, the reasons therefor?
Including crops damaged due to seeds
failure under NAIS
2082.  SHRI ABDUL WAHAB: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the crops covered under National
Agriculture Insurance Scheme (NAIS) at
present; and
(b) whether there is any proposal to
include some crops damaged due to seeds
failure, under NAIS, if so, the details
thereof?
Impact of weak monsoon
2083.  SHRIMA TI THOTA
SEETHARAMA LAKSHMI: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is fact that monsoon is
expected to be weak this season thereby
raising concern about decreased agricultural
production and higher agricultural  prices;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto?
Necessity of second green revolution
†2084.  SHRI LAL SINH V ADODIA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is feeling the necessity of the second Green
Revolution;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

487
(b) if so, whether Government has taken
any steps in this direction; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Implementation of Sub-Mission on
Agricultural Mechanization
2085. SHRI D. KUPENDRA REDDY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Sub-Mission on
Agricultural Mechanization is under
implementation;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
salient features of the Sub-Mission; and
(c) the funds allocated to various States
under the Sub-Mission, State-wise?
Institutional support to livestock
sector
2086. SHRI RAVI PRAKASH
VERMA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the livestock sector has
received less resources and institutional
support as compared to its contribution in
the economy;
(b) if so, the response of Government
thereto;
(c) the steps taken by Government to
increase resources and institutional  support
to the livestock sector;
(d) whether the country still lacks
adequate facilities and infrastructure for
disease diagnosis, reporting epidemiology,
surveillance and forecasting; and
(e) the steps taken by Government for
breed improvement, enhancing availability
of feed and fodder and provision of better
health services?
Promotion of kitchen garden
2087. DR. T.N. SEEMA: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there is a need to improve
crop productivity and efficiency in the value
chains;
(b) if so, the steps taken by Government
in this regard;
(c) whether kitchen gardening and newer
forms of vertical gardening can be of great
help to propagate the cause of environment;
(d) if so, the steps being taken by
Government to create awareness among
households about the potentials of kitchen
as well as organic gardening; and
(e) whether Government has received
any proposal from State Governments
including Government of Kerala for
promotion of kitchen garden or urban
farms, if so, the details thereof?
Implementation of NDP in
Maharashtra
2088. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is
implementing the National Diary  Plan
(NDP) in the country, if so, the details
thereof; and
(b) the present status of implementation
of the NDP in Maharashtra?
Suicide by farmers in Karnataka
2089. SHRI RAJEEV
CHANDRASEKHAR: Will the Minister
of AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of farmers who

488
committed suicide in Karnataka during the
last three months, month-wise;
(b) whether Government has assessed/
has been apprised by the State Government,
the reasons for this alarming rise in farmers'
suicide cases;
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
measures taken by Government in this
regard; and
(d) whether Government is considering
to announce any immediate relief meausres
like special packages/debt waivers etc. for
debt ridden farmers of Karnataka in this
alarming situation, if so, the details thereof?
Study to ascertain financial burden on
farmers
